siding_lap.notes: procedural fiber-cement lap siding, 7in exposure, 12 ft tile

pavers.notes: procedural tumbled concrete pavers, 8 ft tile

mulch.notes: Shredded wood-chip mulch, backyard (rectified ground plane, min-cut seamless).

gravel.notes: Front-yard gravel: it reads as small rounded pea gravel / crushed rock in tan-grey-rust tones rather than fine DG. Cut from the shaded part of the bed (rectified); sun-dapple flattened.

oak_bark.notes: Coast live oak bark from the big trunk at left edge of p08 (two vertical sections side by side, min-cut seams); map with V along the trunk.

oak_floor.notes: procedural wide-plank white oak, 16 ft tile

shake_gable.notes: procedural staggered shakes, colour from p69

tile_bath_large.notes: Primary-bath large-format marble-look porcelain (white with soft grey veining), cut from the shower side wall. Tile = two 24x48in tiles laid horizontally, half-offset, with thin grout; seams fall on grout lines.

tile_herringbone.notes: SEMI-PROCEDURAL: 45-degree herringbone of 2x6in honed tiles (aspect read from p25) with tile and grout colours sampled from the accent wall behind the round mirrors; exact lattice so it tiles perfectly. Non-square tile.

tile_blue_mosaic.notes: SEMI-PROCEDURAL: lower-bath blue glass mosaic, 1x2in stacked cells, per-cell colours drawn from k-means clusters of the real tiles in p68 (weights preserved), glassy gradient + soft highlight, grey grout. 2x2 ft tile.

tile_subway.notes: SEMI-PROCEDURAL: hall-bath glossy white 3x12in subway in running bond, colours sampled from p22; 4x4 ft tile.

tile_subway_band.notes: Accent band (two rows of 1in-tall linear marble/grey mosaic) for the hall-bath stripe; repeats along U only; 2in tall.

quartz_counter.notes: SEMI-PROCEDURAL: white quartz with soft, broken grey veins (domain-warped, exactly periodic); base white and vein grey sampled from the kitchen island (p11). Cutting the real slab produced obviously repeating vein fragments, so this replaces it.

backsplash_slab.notes: SEMI-PROCEDURAL: kitchen full-height marble-look slab backsplash - bolder, more frequent grey veining than the counters, colours sampled from the slab material in p11/p48; exactly periodic 5x5 ft.

shaker_cabinet.notes: SYNTHESIZED single door face (not tiling): white shaker, 2-3/4in rails/stiles, recessed flat centre panel with baked-in soft shading; 15x25in proportions - stretch to each cabinet front. Colour = measured cabinet white.

rec_floor.notes: Lower-level rec-room floor: it is a light beige stone-look tile / LVT (fine mottling, faint straight joints, specular sun patches in p51/p63), NOT carpet. Cut from p72 open floor; joints are too faint to model.

garage_floor.notes: SYNTHESIZED: the garage floor is not visible in p29 (shot looks up at the ceiling/door). Plain sealed grey concrete with a saw-cut control joint every 10 ft at the tile edge.

sisal_rug.notes: Natural sisal/jute flat-weave rug (living room), rectified from the rug left of the glass coffee table. Colour re-balanced to the daylight rug reading in p44 (#b09271); p23 is warm-cast.

oak_leaves.notes: SYNTHESIZED alpha sprite atlas 1024x512: two coast-live-oak leaf clusters (left/right halves, each 512x512 ~3ft across) of small oval leaves with midribs on twigs; leaf colours = k-means of the sunlit/shaded canopy in p52. Use alphaTest ~0.5.
